description: This file defines the TeamDemoData class, which manages creation and management of demo team data for the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for creating demo data, adding users to teams, retrieving random teams or team sets, and seed data for team names and sets.

classes.name: TeamDemoData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and managing demo team data within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the demo data object with a team seed object and optional large scale test flag.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Creates demo data for a list of predefined teams and, if the large scale test flag is set, generates additional teams.

methods.name: add_users_to_team
methods.description: Adds specific users to predefined teams 'West' and 'East'.

methods.name: get_random_team
methods.description: Returns a random team name from the seed data list.

methods.name: get_random_teamset
methods.description: Returns a random team set (array of team names) from predefined seed data.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_team_list
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined team names used for demo data creation.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_teamset_list
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined team sets (arrays of team names) for demo purposes.

methods.name: _quick_create
methods.description: Creates a team with the given name if it does not already exist.
